_comment: Copy to subscribers.json to run fbwatch for more than one person. Delete it (or never create it) and fbwatch runs single-user off config.json + keywords.txt. Each person gets their own trigger-word file and their own destination; Facebook is still scraped only once per cycle.

domin._note: admin: may add people and groups from Discord. discord_user_id links a Discord account so this person can manage their own rules with `!fbw add ...`.

ana._note: Own webhook, own trigger words. Gets nothing until keywords/ana.txt has at least one rule.

marko._note: Telegram instead of Discord, and only this one group. Leave `groups` out to watch all of them. Telegram is notifications-only - configuration stays in Discord.
